rules.height_rules: No part of the dormer or associated roof enlargement should exceed the highest part of the existing roof. A raised ridge will normally require planning permission.
rules.depth_rules: Keep the dormer within the 40 or 50 cubic metre roof-space allowance, depending on house type, and sized so it remains clearly subordinate to the host roof rather than taking over the whole slope.
rules.boundary_rules: Obscure glazing and restricted opening are usually expected on side-facing dormer windows below 1.7m, and close rear-to-rear relationships can still create overlooking issues even where permitted development may apply. rules.roof_rules: The dormer must not sit on the principal roof slope facing a highway. Apart from hip-to-gable work, it should be set back at least 20cm from the eaves and should not include a balcony or roof terrace.
rules.materials_rules: Use external finishes that sit comfortably with the existing roof and walls.
